## Draft vs published

**H1, meta title and meta description shipped exactly as planned.** All three match `publish-package.md` Option A character-for-character. No CMS-side rewrite of the metadata.

**The body was rewritten after v6.** The live copy is shorter (~2,000 vs ~2,540 words) and materially more hedged than `draft-v6-revision2.md`. Concretely:

1. **New section added — "How the GLP-1 Market Structure Is Changing."** Not present in any local draft. It covers Novo Nordisk / Eli Lilly competitive segmentation and the shift toward oral and combination therapies, citing two sources that appear nowhere in the drafts:
   - [Reuters, 2026-08-13](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/novo-ceo-says-obesity-market-wont-be-winner-take-all-battle-with-lilly-2026-08-13/) — Novo CEO on the obesity market not being winner-take-all.
   - [IQVIA, outlook for obesity 2026–2030](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/emea/blogs/2026/04/the-outlook-for-obesity-from-2026-to-2030) — oral GLP-1s and combination therapies.
2. **"GLP-1 Market Size and Growth Trajectory" was converted into a four-row market-indicator table** (2030 forecast · projected US adoption · employer coverage · utilization and spending), each row carrying an inline citation and a "what it indicates" column. v6 carried the same material as running prose.
3. **Claims were softened or dropped.** v6's patient-count trajectory ("about 6 million in 2024 to roughly 10 million in 2025 … 25 to 30 million by 2030") is gone; the live page states "approximately 25 million people … by 2030" only. The $200B figure is now explicitly scoped as covering "a broader category than GLP-1 receptor agonists alone," and the KFF findings are explicitly limited to "the surveyed firms and the benefit designs represented in the study."
4. **Heading renames:** "What Better GLP-1 Progress Tracking Looks Like" → **"What Scalable GLP-1 Progress Tracking Requires"** · "Frequently Asked Questions" → **"FAQ"** · "Next Steps" (H3) → **"Next Step"** (H2).
5. **A "How the GLP-1 Care Ecosystem Is Evolving" rewrite** splits the delivery models into four labelled paragraphs (telehealth · in-person and hybrid · pharmacy-led · employer-supported) with per-model data-access and jurisdiction caveats.
6. **Compliance framing was expanded in "Where FitXpress Fits":** the live page names the GDPR controller/processor split and HIPAA business-associate position explicitly. It also references the Data, Privacy, Security & Regulatory resource as plain text — **not as a link**, because that page is still an unpublished P0 gap.
7. **The v6 "several adjacent topics have their own pages" link paragraph was removed** from the intro; those links are now distributed inline through the body instead.
8. **The [GLP-1 Compliance Challenge](https://3dlook.ai/content-hub/glp-1-compliance-challenge/) link present in v6 does not appear on the live page.**
9. **Scope note retained**, reworded and tightened.
10. **Author spelling differs from the drafts.** Every draft carries `author: Assel Sekerova`; the live byline reads **Asselya Sekerova**. Same pattern as `top-7-remote-body-composition-tools-glp-1-clinics` and `mobile-body-scanning-patient-engagement`. Draft `author:` fields left untouched to preserve the historical artefacts.
